the design and modeling of retrograded double QWs in PMOS devices.
the analysis and optimization of retrograded double QWs in MOS devices for improved device performance.

the retrograded double QWs are an excellent choice for the realization of high-performance QW-PMOST devices in bulk silicon technology.
the retrograded double QWs are a viable alternative to the single QW structure for realizing high performance MOSFETs in silicon technology.

a double QW structure is a viable candidate for realizing high performance MOSFETs with a low threshold voltage.

the QW-PMOSS are superior to their conventional bulk counterparts.
the double QW structures are the best suited for the realization of high-performance MOSFETs.
